Folder.Hint: Where portraits and tokens are saved. Leave empty to use worlds/<world>/framed-tokens.

Format.Hint: PNG has the widest support; WebP makes smaller files.

Placed.Name: Tokens already on scenes
Placed.Hint: Which of the actor's tokens already placed on scenes also receive the new image.

Click.Name: Open on portrait click
Click.Hint: Clicking the portrait on an actor sheet opens this dialog. Shift+click keeps the system's default file picker.
